name: Lisa
notes: A 4-star Electro sub-DPS whose every talent scales with ATK. Both sources put the Burst (Lightning Rose) first and the Skill second (KQM: Burst >= Skill > Normal Attack), so the damage talent is the Burst; her Hold Skill carries her on-field damage in KQM's builds. The sources differ on the set: KQM puts 4pc Thundering Fury first for her Dendro teams, Game8 puts Gilded Dreams (Overload or Dendro reactions), Emblem of Severed Fate (Electro Burst sub-DPS) and Noblesse Oblige (support) by build, so the list holds all four. Mains are close (ATK% or EM Sands, Electro DMG Goblet, CRIT Circlet); Game8 also allows ER on the Sands for the support build. The weapons agree on Kagura's Verity (Game8's best, KQM's competitive option); KQM's best is Reliquary of Truth. Neither source gives stat goals, so only ER is set: 160% is the upper end of KQM's Electro Resonance off-field range with one Hold Skill (130-160%); on-field in Electro Resonance it is 100-130%. Atk, CR and CD goals are left to the role's default.
